description: Graded qrels for ThumbGate retrieval ranking (Recall@k / MRR / nDCG / Precision@k). Expanded A+ set (2026-07-31). Self-contained CI corpus.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: force-push to main
corpus.content: NEVER force-push or git push --force to main/master. Use --force-with-lease only on personal branches after review. Protected branch history must not be rewritten.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: claimed deployed without health check
corpus.content: ALWAYS verify /health endpoint returns the new version after deploy. NEVER say deployed without curling health and matching version. Wait 2-5 minutes after Railway rebuild.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: PaymentIntent without idempotency key
corpus.content: ALWAYS use idempotency keys on PaymentIntent creation to prevent duplicate charges. NEVER create charges without an idempotency key in production Stripe flows.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: stored raw card numbers
corpus.content: NEVER log or store raw card numbers. Use Stripe tokens or PaymentMethod IDs. Card PAN storage is a PCI violation.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: drop table without backup
corpus.content: ALWAYS back up the database before running destructive migrations. NEVER drop users table or truncate production tables without a restore point.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: migrate deploy without test database
corpus.content: ALWAYS run migrations against a test database first. NEVER run prisma migrate deploy in production without verifying on staging.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: committed .env secrets
corpus.content: NEVER commit .env files, API keys, or PEMs to git. Redact secrets from logs and PR bodies. Rotate any leaked credential immediately.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: said done without gh pr view
corpus.content: NEVER say done, pushed, or shipped without showing gh pr view output and green CI. Open PR with auto-merge is not done.

corpus.title: SUCCESS: dashboard button spacing
corpus.content: Adjusted CSS padding on the dashboard stat cards for mobile. Visual polish only; no gate or retrieval impact.

corpus.title: SUCCESS: typo in README
corpus.content: Fixed a spelling typo in the install section of the README. No behavioral change.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: rebase of shared branch
corpus.content: NEVER rebase a branch that others have already pulled. Prefer merge commits on shared feature branches.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: webhook without signature verify
corpus.content: ALWAYS verify Stripe webhook signatures with constructEvent before processing. NEVER trust raw webhook bodies.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: recursive delete of production data
corpus.content: NEVER run recursive force-delete on production paths or database directories without a restore snapshot. Prefer soft-delete and scoped cleanup scripts.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: two executors on one agent thread
corpus.content: ALWAYS enforce one-thread-one-executor with a 90-second renewable lease. Two active executors cause double writes worse than stall.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: republish on Hashnode after AutoMod
corpus.content: NEVER publish or re-publish on Hashnode while AutoMod freeze is active. Prefer Medium and dev.to for longform with buy links.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: raw gh pr merge auto on main
corpus.content: ALWAYS use npm run pr:manage or trunk merge for main. NEVER raw gh pr merge auto around required checks.

corpus.title: SUCCESS: weather note
corpus.content: Recorded that the office AC was fixed. Unrelated to agents or gates.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: git checkout on main checkout instead of isolated worktree
corpus.content: NEVER run git checkout -b or switch branches inside the shared main checkout. Always create an isolated git worktree per task and stay inside it even when a commit is empty.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: live Stripe session opened via restricted rk_live_ key
corpus.content: NEVER probe Stripe Checkout with rk_live_ or sk_live_ keys in verification scripts. Guard both sk_live_ and rk_live_ prefixes so synthetic probes never open live checkout sessions.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: miscounted Trunk merge-queue test PRs as wasted work
corpus.content: NEVER count closed Trunk merge-queue test PRs (author app/trunk-io, branch trunk-merge/*) as unmerged human or agent PRs when auditing repository throughput.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: launchctl print leaked inherited environment secrets
corpus.content: NEVER print raw launchctl environment blocks, printenv, or env dumps in tool output. Filter variable names only and redact secret values before logging.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: merged BLOCKED Dependabot PR without required checks
corpus.content: NEVER assume a Dependabot pull request is mergeable when mergeStateStatus is BLOCKED. Inspect statusCheckRollup and wait for required CI workflows to complete.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: sent empty thumb feedback before user entered context
corpus.content: NEVER fire POST /api/feedback on initial thumb click before the context input is submitted. Require one-line why context so vague bare votes do not pollute lesson promotion.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: opened src/scripts PR without .changeset file
corpus.content: ALWAYS include a .changeset/<slug>.md patch entry whenever a pull request modifies src/, scripts/, bin/, or public/ so Verify changeset passes in CI.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: raised npm unpackedSize ceiling instead of trimming tarball
corpus.content: NEVER raise the npm pack unpackedSize or fileCount ceiling in package-boundary tests to silence a failure. Exclude non-runtime fixtures in package.json files or trim bloat.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: reported checkout handoff clicks as paid Stripe revenue
corpus.content: NEVER report checkout CTA clicks, session creations, or page views as paid orders or revenue. Only reconciled paid Stripe charges with non-test keys count as revenue.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: bypassed PR body template via raw gh api pulls POST
corpus.content: NEVER call gh api repos/.../pulls -X POST to skip pull request templates or pre-push checks. Use standard PR creation with verification evidence and npm run pr:manage.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: passed --no-verify to skip PreToolUse or git hooks
corpus.content: NEVER run git commit --no-verify, git push --no-verify, or set THUMBGATE_HOTFIX_BYPASS to silence failing hooks. Fix the underlying gate or test failure.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: lessons.sqlite out of sync with lessons-index.jsonl
corpus.content: ALWAYS sync lessons.sqlite and backfill lesson embeddings after mutating lessons-index.jsonl so hybrid lexical and vector retrieval see identical records.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: edited golden set without re-sealing double-blind holdout
corpus.content: ALWAYS run eval:holdout:freeze and eval:holdout:check when updating mined golden sets, and never leak raw holdout command text into the holdout manifest.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: pasted plaintext password or sk- key into agent prompt
corpus.content: NEVER echo or store plaintext passwords, PEM private keys, or sk-/ghp_/AKIA tokens submitted in UserPromptSubmit hooks; block the prompt and record only redacted metadata.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: link-scanner bots created phantom Stripe Checkout sessions
corpus.content: ALWAYS block headless crawlers, link previewers, and synthetic probes on /go/pro checkout redirects so bot traffic does not inflate checkout abandonment metrics.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: asked user to click Resolve conversation on GitHub
corpus.content: NEVER delegate routine engineering steps, PR review thread fixes, or CI checks back to the human operator. Fix the code, push, and verify autonomously.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: git clean -fdx wiped untracked local state
corpus.content: NEVER run git clean -fd or git clean -fdx without explicit operator approval; untracked .thumbgate state and local notes are permanently destroyed.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: git reset --hard discarded uncommitted edits
corpus.content: NEVER run git reset --hard on a dirty working tree to recover from a merge conflict; stash or inspect git diff first so peer edits are not lost.

corpus.title: SUCCESS: aligned README badge markdown
corpus.content: Wrapped two badge links onto one line in README.md. Documentation formatting only; no runtime, gate, or billing effect.

corpus.title: SUCCESS: tweaked pricing card border radius
corpus.content: Changed border-radius from 10px to 12px on pricing cards in CSS. Purely cosmetic styling change.
